subject.title: Telegram: support fail-closed unknown-group handling with optional auto-leave

question: Should OpenClaw accept opt-in Telegram unknown-group warning/auto-leave behavior, and should the paired implementation PR be the vehicle after proof and review?
rationale: The request adds new Telegram config and a destructive Bot API side effect for unauthorized groups, so maintainer intent is needed before implementation lands.

options.title: Review the paired PR
options.body: Use the open same-author PR as the implementation candidate, requiring precise unknown-group classification, docs/schema updates, and real Telegram proof before merge.

options.title: Replace with a narrower design
options.body: Ask for a narrower successor if maintainers want warn-only, audit-only, or no auto-leave behavior.

options.title: Reject auto-leave
options.body: Close this issue and the paired PR if maintainers decide group membership cleanup should stay manual or external.

recommendation.title: Review the paired PR
recommendation.body: Use the open same-author PR as the implementation candidate, requiring precise unknown-group classification, docs/schema updates, and real Telegram proof before merge.
